text: ポケモンに　こいつを　おしえりゃ　たのしく　なるぜ！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　こいつを　おしえりゃ
structure.en: if you teach this to a Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to ば means 'if'. おしえりゃ is the rough, slurred spoken form of おしえれば. おしえりゃ = 'if you teach it'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become' that way. たのしく　なる = 'it gets fun'.
